notes: Illustrations generated without lettering. Existing repository SVG wordmark and app icon provide branding. Vector layouts and exact-size PNG/JPG/icon exports are assembled by export.cjs. All gameplay screenshots are unretouched captures of the actual game; none are AI-generated.

prompts.optionA:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: high resolution Steam game key art concept A, "Grid atlas"; no text, illustration only, landscape 3072x2048 or larger.
Game: Electrify is a thoughtful electricity market management/tycoon game played with charts, facility cards, changing demand and weather. The artwork must communicate electricity strategy rather than depict a literal city-building 3D world.
Primary request: an exceptionally polished graphic poster showing a small abstract power network: one dramatic electric-blue transmission pylon on the right, a few wind turbines, a bank of solar panels and compact town silhouettes arranged as simple bold geometric shapes. Restrained branching blue circuit paths connect sources to demand. Huge clear shapes, confident deliberate geometry, spacious art-directed composition. Broad calm navy negative space across the upper left half for the existing title to be composited separately. Facilities predominantly in lower right and lower third; one strong focal point, no busy collage.
Style/medium: premium flat screenprint/vector-like editorial illustration, crisp black outlines, flat fills, clean curves, no gradients, no glow, no photorealism, no textures, no faux UI. The existing brand is electric blue #0084F8, dark cool navy #111D2C, cool white, subtle muted teal and amber limited to facility surfaces. The mood is smart, strategic, optimistic, sophisticated, not childish.
Composition must work in landscape and later portrait versions. Full bleed, generous breathing room around silhouettes. No border. No text, numbers, letters, watermark, labels, brandmarks, logos, badges, icons in circles or visible card UI. No sprawling realistic metropolis, no mountains as main subject. Electrify title will be added from a separate actual SVG.
prompts.optionB:
Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: Steam key art concept B, "Power portfolio", landscape high resolution illustration, ideally 3072x2048. No title or text: existing vector wordmark will be added separately.
Electrify is an electricity market strategy game with charts, facility investments and energy tradeoffs. Create a premium bold graphic poster, deliberate flat geometric editorial design echoing flat black-outlined game icons. A dramatic oversized turbine rotor, geometric solar array, abstract hydro turbine and a compact power station overlap as a balanced curated collection of investments along the lower third and right half. A quiet flowing blue supply-and-demand curve connects the composition; it is an abstract visual motif, never fake UI. Strong clean silhouettes, 3-5 large forms, rich electric blue #0084F8 and cool white against deep navy #101D2B, small muted teal, yellow only on facility details. Confident black outlines, flat fills, precise curves. Some circular facility forms but not a repetitive grid of cards or stickers. Upper left half is calm dark space reserved for the title. Facilities are tactile symbols of strategic choices, not an explorable 3D world. Beautiful restrained visual rhythm, clean separations, no clutter, no glow, no gradients, no simulated screenshot, no photorealism, no lettering, numbers, words, badges, watermark or border. Full bleed. This option should feel more iconic and graphic than a landscape of power lines.
prompts.landscape:
Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: Steam game key art concept C, "Dispatch desk", landscape 3072x2048 high resolution. No text, titles, letters or numbers.
Electrify is a chart-and-card electricity market strategy game, with generators, changing demand, storage, financial choices and weather shocks. Create a premium graphic editorial poster inspired by a power dispatch board. A very bold elegant luminous-blue supply curve with three large understated circular junctions flows across a dark cool navy field. Under and around it are only three strong flat black-outlined silhouettes: a wind rotor, a solar array and a compact stylized power station, organized into a graphic diagonal composition to the right and lower half. Add a restrained abstract pale demand curve crossing behind it, and broad rectangular geometric blocks indicating portfolio structure without literal UI. Huge clean forms with generous negative space, 1970s modernist infrastructure poster meets contemporary indie management-game cover design. Precise geometric shapes, flat fills, electric blue #0084F8, cool white, deep navy #102031 with a tiny amber accent at the crossing of supply and demand. No city landscape, no 3D scene, no mountains, no realistic desk, no computer screens. Make it striking and art-directed, not corporate clipart or an educational infographic. Keep upper left half dark and calm for compositing existing wordmark later. No gradients, glow, texture, labels, line-chart axes, tiny decoration, watermark, border, badges or words.
